en.title: Daily Action Flow, September 30, 2026
en.description: Eight actions connect available capabilities with verified work.
en.centralJudgment: Price the whole path to accepted outcomes. Models, financing and distribution each require a different completion test.
en.fieldLine: Eight signals. Defined work. Honest completion.

actions.domain: Frontier Models and Agents
actions.title: Specify the delegated-work comparison
actions.why: The practical question is whether one repeatable workflow can finish with fewer interventions at an acceptable total cost.
steps: Save a comparison specification for one bounded workflow across GPT-6.1 Sol and the existing baseline, counting accepted outcomes, total spend, retries and human interventions; do not run paid calls.
Advance only when dated evidence meets the stated acceptance condition.
actions.done: READY; specification saved, paid evaluation unexecuted.

actions.domain: Physical AI and Robotics
actions.title: Record the airport evidence test
actions.why: The software workflow behind the robot may matter as much as its physical form.
steps: Save a deployment evidence card requiring completed passenger requests, human handoffs and service availability before treating Nova as proven labor substitution.
Advance only when dated evidence meets the stated acceptance condition.
actions.done: READY; deployment evidence requirements saved, labor savings unproven.

actions.domain: Crypto Capital Flows and Web3 Health
actions.title: Watch NRR net creations
actions.why: Agent-related crypto narratives need a capital-flow test independent of token price and issuer marketing.
steps: Keep a first-week NRR watch card open until dated net creations can be distinguished from seed capital and secondary trading volume.
Advance only when dated evidence meets the stated acceptance condition.
actions.done: WATCHING; seed and net-creation evidence required.

actions.domain: Stablecoins, FinTech, Payment Standards and Token Rails
actions.title: Keep the regulatory watchpoint
actions.why: Payments experience helps separate a procedural route from permission to launch a service.
steps: Maintain the standing watchpoint for a final rule or a named issuer approval, without advancing the proposal to an implemented payment rail.
Advance only when dated evidence meets the stated acceptance condition.
actions.done: WATCHING; final rule or named approval required.

actions.domain: iamrobin.ai Content, Distribution and Visibility
actions.title: Publish the robot-practice essay
actions.why: This connects Robin’s capital-allocation lens with an understandable mechanism behind Physical AI.
steps: Publish Who Pays for the Robot’s Practice at the [canonical destination](https://iamrobin.ai/ouroboros/202609/20260930/action_item/), with an evidence spine of the acquisition agreement, model functions, simulation transfer, total trial costs and a proposed acceptance test; use five primary sources, a conceptual diagram and an archived LinkedIn derivative.
Advance only when dated evidence meets the stated acceptance condition.
actions.done: COMPLETE as an editorial artifact; public delivery has separate gates.

actions.domain: AI Infrastructure, Career Opportunities and Capital Projects
actions.title: Separate Helix capital and delivery
actions.why: Infrastructure analysis should connect who supplies capital with who carries construction and power-delivery obligations.
steps: Save a Helix capital-to-delivery card separating announced investment, project commitments, power milestones and operating capacity, leaving undisclosed terms unresolved.
Advance only when dated evidence meets the stated acceptance condition.
actions.done: READY; investment, projects, power and operations separated.

actions.domain: Late-Stage Private Markets
actions.title: Watch General Intuition terms
actions.why: This is a relevant capital watchpoint at the intersection of world models, simulation and robotics.
steps: Keep General Intuition on WATCH pending financing terms and independently corroborated paid customer outcomes; make no investment or application.
Advance only when dated evidence meets the stated acceptance condition.
actions.done: WATCHING; terms, access and independently corroborated outcomes required.

actions.domain: Public Equities and AI/Physical-AI Themes
actions.title: Record the AMD acquisition bridge
actions.why: The valuation question connects share issuance, integration and workload demand rather than treating the announcement as immediate earnings.
steps: Save an acquisition bridge with announced consideration, closing conditions, eventual dilution and disclosed commercial milestones; leave unreported synergies blank.
Advance only when dated evidence meets the stated acceptance condition.
actions.done: READY; agreement recorded; closing, dilution and synergies remain to be verified.

ja.title: デイリー・アクション・フロー、2026年9月30日
ja.description: 八つの行動で利用できる能力と検証済み成果をつなぐ。
ja.centralJudgment: 受入済み成果までの総費用を見る。モデル、資金、販売経路にはそれぞれ違う完了確認が必要だ。
ja.fieldLine: 八つのシグナル。定義した仕事。正確な完了記録。

actions.domain: 最先端モデルとエージェント｜委任の低コスト経路が増える
actions.title: 委任業務の比較仕様を定義
actions.why: 一つの反復業務を、許容できる総費用と少ない人の介入で完了できるかが実務の問いだ。
steps: 範囲を限定した業務についてGPT-6.1 Solと現行基準を比較する仕様を保存し、受入済み成果、総支出、再試行、人の介入を数える。有料呼出しは実行しない。
受入条件を満たす日付付き証拠が出たときだけ進める。
actions.done: READY。仕様を保存。有料評価は未実施。

actions.domain: Physical AIとロボティクス｜空港で接客の実需に向き合う
actions.title: 空港導入の証拠条件を記録

steps: 完了した旅客依頼、人への引継ぎ、可用性を求める導入証拠カードを保存し、労働代替が実証済みとは扱わない。
受入条件を満たす日付付き証拠が出たときだけ進める。
actions.done: READY。必要証拠を保存。労働費削減は未証明。

受入条件を満たす日付付き証拠が出たときだけ進める。

actions.domain: ステーブルコインと決済標準｜提案の段階を守る

受入条件を満たす日付付き証拠が出たときだけ進める。
